title: Lab - Manage processes and analyse log files
description: Find a misbehaving process and read what the system logged about it.
scenario: Find a misbehaving process and read what the system logged about it. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Top talker
tasks.instructions: Find the process using the most CPU and its PID.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Renice
tasks.instructions: Lower its priority to 10 without restarting it.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Journal
tasks.instructions: Show the kernel messages from the current boot and the sshd logs from the last hour.
